blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Transport group Pagkakaisa ng mga Samahan ng Tsuper at Opereytor Nationwide (Piston) will hold a caravan on Wednesday for one of its leaders who died. A caravan for 78-year-old jeepney driver Elmer Cordero, known as “Tatay Elmer,” whose body will be brought to Claret Church in Diliman, Quezon City at 1 p.m. The caravan goes ahead of Cordero’s 2 p.m. cremation at St. Peter Chapels La Loma in Caloocan, Piston announced on Tuesday.
